name: Saman Bandara, Ph.D.
expertise: Agricultural economics; agribusiness; natural resource economics; economic development
bio: Dr. Saman Bandara is an Associate Professor of Economics at West Virginia State University. His research and outreach interests include agricultural economics, agribusiness, natural resource economics, and economic development. His faculty profile is included in the ERS–WVSU research community; this listing does not identify a completed ERS–WVSU seminar.
